feature_name: OTEL Host Configuration for Envoy Telemetry
description: Add support for host/port configuration in the Helm chart for Envoy OpenTelemetry metric sinks. This feature should allow users to specify collector endpoints directly via host/port instead of requiring backendRefs, which resolves cross-namespace compatibility issues. The implementation must validate that only one configuration method (host/port OR backendRefs) is used at a time.
functional_requirements: Add host and port configuration fields to the Envoy metrics sink section in the Helm chart values
Implement validation logic that prevents simultaneous use of both host/port and backendRefs configurations
Add validation that ensures at least one configuration method (host/port OR backendRefs) is provided
Update Helm chart documentation to explain the new host/port configuration option and its use for cross-namespace collectors
